frozen_by: WorkBuddy autonomous project lead (authorised by the 2026-10-15 owner mandate)
note: V02 protocol, FROZEN before any V02 real episode. This freeze is an autonomous engineering/scientific decision by the project lead with reasons in docs/AUTONOMOUS_DECISIONS.md (D28-D36); it is NOT external peer review and must not be described as such. V01's unapproved D4/D5/D6 are NOT thereby approved. No arbitrary default is ever used: an UNSET parameter raises rather than defaulting.

gap_intervention_m.note: condition 10/11 adds +2.0 m to front_gap; carried over from V01 for continuity

speed_intervention_mps.note: condition 01/11 subtracts 1.0 m/s from ego_speed; carried over from V01 for continuity

tau_cap_s.note: right-censoring ceiling for Layer-2 CENSORED / NO_CANDIDATE; far above every observed finite min-TTC (~0.9-1.5 s) so it never truncates a real finite value

tau_low_threshold_s.note: M2 = fraction of policy steps with forward TTC < 1.0 s

delta_eq_s.note: reversal margin for the auxiliary nomination-quality indicator R_a; fixed from mechanism scale (typical |Delta| is 0.02-0.35 s) and NOT tuned to any method

alpha.note: two-sided alpha for descriptive interval reporting only

analysis_seed.note: fixed analysis RNG seed for every bootstrap; never result-picked

no_candidate_policy.note: primary (b): a NO_CANDIDATE episode is assigned tau_cap and flagged; sensitivity (a) exclude is reported alongside

i_log_floor_phi_s.note: no floor approved: pure I_log stays UNDEFINED on 0/inf/missing, reported by reason code

sampling_assumption_basis.note: sign-flip/max-T validity conditions A/B/C are not established, so confirmatory tests stay PENDING and no p-value is produced. NOT self-approved.

perturbation_front_gap_halfwidth_m.note: P2: shared within-anchor jitter of the initial front gap

perturbation_front_speed_halfwidth_mps.note: P1: shared within-anchor jitter of the lead initial speed (upstream ties lead speed to its target speed)

perturbation_ego_speed_halfwidth_mps.note: P4: shared within-anchor jitter of the ego initial speed (intervention is applied on top)

anchor_domain.note: V02 anchor domain: narrowed to the closing/interaction regime, with perturbation+intervention margins so all four conditions stay inside the upstream BOUNDS (rejection sampling, never clipping)

v02_master_seed.note: SHA256(canonical_json(['SafeFlipLab-v02','dev-master',0])) truncated to 32 bits; deterministic, never result-picked; V02 dev phase only

s2_min_s2.note: G3a gate: within-anchor variance of min-TTC must be strictly greater than 0 (exclusive) for the perturbation to be valid; the stronger s2_min refinement is deferred to the formal design step

n_events_min.note: G3b: fewer than 1 observed collision event in the pilot means the binary endpoint is reported descriptively only
